title: Phase 2 per-case row (one JSON object per line in p2/*.jsonl)
description: Extends the flat rows already in p2/ (system, equation, seed, split_id, r2, status, formula, generation_path, llm_called, bypass_used, runtime_s, timeout_s, model_id, code_version, config_hash, evaluator_version, _source). New required fields are marked NEW in their description. Python's json module writes -Infinity/NaN, which is not strict JSON; readers must accept it (phase2_close.py and reflatten_fields.py do).

seed.description: Fixes data generation and the train/test split. The LLM API is not seeded by this value.

split_id.description: Must equal the split_id of the HDS row for the same (equation, seed).

r2.description: Primary score. MUST equal extrap_r2_far (value as returned by r2_scored, so below -100 appears as -Infinity). null only when status is timeout, error or no_formula.

r2_field.description: NEW. Name of the field copied into r2.

r2_raw.description: NEW. Far-regime R^2 from r2_checked() on the same arrays, i.e. BEFORE the -100 floor and 1e100 limit of r2_scored(). Lets a -Infinity be told apart from a finite very bad fit.

r2_status.description: NEW. Status returned by r2_scored() for the far regime. not_scored when no formula was produced.

train_r2.description: NEW in this file (present in source JSON for older rows).

status.description: Run status, not scoring status. A -Infinity score is still status ok.

formula.description: The formula string exactly as scored. null only if status is not ok.

generation_path.description: Which path produced the formula, e.g. pure_llm_direct. Never a hardcoded path for pure_llm.

runtime_s.description: Wall-clock seconds from case start to final formula returned, INCLUDING all LLM calls and retries; excluding data generation and scoring.

timeout_s.description: The enforced wall-clock cap for this row. Must be identical for all pure_llm rows.

model_id.description: Pinned model identifier; must equal the HDS rows' model_id.

model_returned.description: NEW, optional but recommended. Model name echoed back in the API response; compare with model_id to detect silent alias changes.

git_commit.description: NEW. Output of git rev-parse HEAD at run start.

code_dirty.description: NEW. True if the working tree had uncommitted changes at run start. Must be false.

evaluator_version.description: Must equal the HDS rows', e.g. r2_canonical@8f11733.

prompt_sha256.description: NEW. SHA-256 of the final prompt template (before variable substitution). Must be identical across all pure_llm rows.

config_diff.description: Phase 3 needs this; for Phase 2 it is [].

$comment: PROPOSED by phase2_finish.py: removed from required ['ablated_component', 'bypass_used', 'code_dirty', 'code_version', 'config_diff', 'config_hash', 'evaluator_version', 'formula', 'input_tokens', 'model_id', 'n_llm_calls', 'output_tokens', 'r2_field', 'status', 'temperature']; enum additions {'r2_status': ['failed:no_calls']}. Apply only via a logged amendment.
